company.name: Lyst
company.shortDescription: Lyst is a global fashion search platform that allows users to browse through thousands of online fashion stores.
company.description:
Lyst is a global fashion search platform used by 70 million shoppers every year. Offering over 4 million fashion products from 11,000 of the world’s leading fashion brands and stores, Lyst brings together the widest inventory in luxury and contemporary fashion online.

 The company has raised $60 million to date, and is backed by range of all-star investors including 14W (Moda Operandi, Reformation), Accel Partners (Facebook, Spotify), Balderton (Yoox Net-A-Porter Group), Draper Esprit, part of the Draper Venture Network (Hotmail, Skype), and the teams behind LVMH, Michael Kors, Oscar de la Renta, and Tory Burch.

productsAndServices.description: A global online platform that aggregates fashion products from thousands of brands and stores, enabling users to search, browse, and compare fashion items in one place.
productsAndServices.name: Lyst Fashion Search Platform

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $85,000,000, or 59.03% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,480,446 to $700,000,000, a 201.12x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
